summary_1line: Death, disguised as an ascetic messenger, arrives to speak privately with Rama under a strict condition that any eavesdropper must be executed.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant ascetic glowing like the sun stands at Rama’s palace gate as Lakshmana respectfully receives him.
The luminous ascetic sits upon a golden throne before Rama in the royal hall, his body surrounded by fiery rays.
Rama solemnly instructs Lakshmana to guard the door while he meets the mysterious ascetic in strict secrecy.
